developer.backupDescription: Resets this device’s backup status and opens the home screen. Add at least one account to see the reminder. Accounts and backup files are not changed.
developer.wipeDescription: Delete all local accounts and app settings, then return to onboarding. Exported backups and files in your sync folder are not deleted.
developer.wipeWarning: Delete all local accounts and app settings on this device? This cannot be undone. Exported backups and files in your sync folder will remain.

backup.never: No export recorded on this device
backup.changed: Accounts changed since the last export
backup.reminder: Keep a backup of your accounts. Sync is not an independent backup.

vaultUi.deferred: Tauthy couldn’t finish setting up secure storage. Your accounts still work. Try again and allow access if prompted.
vaultUi.replaceExplanation: For recovery from a password-protected vault.tauthy file only. To add accounts from a backup, use Import instead. Device-protected files are not portable backups.
vaultUi.replaceWarning: This replaces all local accounts and disconnects sync. Cloud files are not deleted. Keep an independent export first; reconnect sync after replacement.
vaultUi.replaceResume: Reselect the original file and use the same target password chosen before the interruption. Leave the target password empty only if you chose device protection.
vaultUi.replaceConfirm: Replace my local vault and disconnect copied sync settings.
vaultUi.createHint: Choose a password, or leave it blank to open Tauthy without one.

vaultErrors.migrationRequired: Complete the storage upgrade before changing protection or replacing the vault.
vaultErrors.corrupt: The vault cannot be read. Restore an independent backup; do not delete the original.
vaultErrors.unsupported: This vault format is not supported.
vaultErrors.platform: This storage location is not supported. On Windows, Tauthy requires a fixed local NTFS drive.
vaultErrors.identity: This file belongs to a different vault. It requires an explicitly confirmed import.
vaultErrors.missing: The expected vault file is missing. Restore it or use explicit vault deletion to start over.
vaultErrors.credentialMissing: This device's vault key is missing. Restore an independent export or sync copy.
vaultErrors.credentialUnavailable: The device credential store is unavailable. Migration cannot continue yet.
vaultErrors.credentialDenied: Access to the device credential store was denied. Allow access and retry.
vaultErrors.credentialMalformed: The stored device key cannot be read. It has not been overwritten.
vaultErrors.reconciliation: Vault files do not match the saved transaction. Keep the files and recover from a backup.
vaultErrors.stagedCleanup: The active vault is readable, but vault.pending.tauthy could not be safely cleaned up. Keep the files for recovery.
vaultErrors.copyCleanup: A legacy migration working copy could not be safely cleaned up. Keep the files for recovery.
vaultErrors.preparation: An interrupted protection change or import needs its original passwords and confirmation to resume.
vaultErrors.tooLarge: The vault exceeds the supported size limit.
vaultErrors.emptyPassword: Choose a nonempty password or device protection.
vaultErrors.io: Unable to access vault files. Check permissions and available disk space.
vaultErrors.foreignCredential: A device-protected vault file cannot be imported on another device. Use an encrypted export or sync instead.
vaultErrors.generic: The vault operation failed. Please try again.

welcome.subtitle: Your codes, ready when you need them.

codes.empty: <add>Add an entry</add>, <import>import a backup</import>, or <sync>connect sync</sync>

settings.importDescription: Import accounts or export a backup

appearance.trayDescription: Quickly copy codes while Tauthy is running

security.passwordDescription: Set a password for unlocking your vault
security.autoLockDescription: Lock app after 1 minute of inactivity
security.deleteVaultDescription: Remove this device's vault; exported backups and sync files remain

import.importDescription: Import accounts from a backup or text file
import.exportDescription: Create a password-protected or plain text backup

sync.chooseMethod: Choose how to sync your accounts.
sync.folderDescription: Works with Nextcloud, Dropbox, and other cloud folders
sync.folderSetupDescription: Use a folder synced by Nextcloud, Dropbox, or another cloud service.
sync.description: Sync encrypted accounts through this folder. Each device writes its own file, and local changes work offline.
sync.createDescription: Choose a cloud-synced location; Tauthy creates a Tauthy Sync folder there
sync.joinDescription: Select a Tauthy Sync folder, or a folder containing one older sync file
sync.createPasswordDescription: You will need this password to connect another device or recover your accounts. Tauthy cannot recover it for you.
sync.joinPasswordDescription: Enter the recovery password used when this sync was created.
sync.mergeConflictedCopyDescription: Recover changes from a file your cloud service marked as conflicted. The selected file is kept.
sync.disconnectDescription: Stop syncing without deleting local accounts or sync data
sync.disconnectWarning: This device will stop syncing. Your local accounts and encrypted sync data will not be deleted. Continue?
sync.pubkyConnectDescription: Sync encrypted accounts through your Pubky homeserver
sync.pubkyApproval: Scan this code with <ring>Pubky Ring</ring> and approve access to Tauthy's private sync folder. Your accounts stay encrypted, and Tauthy never sees your identity key.
sync.pubkyWaiting: Waiting for approval in Pubky Ring…
sync.pubkyCreateDescription: No Tauthy sync data was found for this Pubky identity. Create an encrypted sync set on its homeserver?
sync.pubkyJoinDescription: Tauthy sync data was found. Enter the recovery code from a connected device to decrypt it.
sync.pubkySaveCode: Save this code securely. It is needed to connect another device if this vault is unavailable. Tauthy can show it again while this vault is unlocked.
sync.pubkyDescription: Sync encrypted accounts through your Pubky homeserver. Each device writes its own file; local changes work offline.
sync.pubkyShowCodeDescription: Use this to connect another device
sync.pubkyDisconnectWarning: This device will stop syncing with Pubky. Local accounts and encrypted homeserver data remain. You can revoke Tauthy's access in Pubky Ring. Continue?
sync.pubkyDeleteDescription: Permanently remove all Tauthy sync files for this identity
sync.pubkyDeleteWarning: Delete Pubky sync data from the homeserver? Your accounts remain on each device, but syncing will stop.

modals.password: Choose a password for your encrypted vault
modals.passwordInsecure: Password should be at least 8 characters
modals.importPasswordDescription: Enter the password used to encrypt this {{format}} backup.
modals.exportPasswordDescription: Choose a password you will remember. Tauthy cannot recover it for you.
modals.deleteWarning: Delete the vault on this device? Its accounts and sync connection will be removed. Exported backups and files in your sync folder will remain.
modals.exportWarning: This export is not encrypted and contains your authentication secrets. Store it securely. Continue?

toasts.importEncryptedAuthenticationFailed: The password is incorrect, or the backup has been damaged or modified.
toasts.importEncryptedCorrupt: The encrypted backup is corrupted or has been modified.
toasts.importEncryptedUnsupported: This backup version or encryption configuration is not supported.
toasts.importEncryptedNoPasswordKey: This backup has no password key and can only be unlocked by its original app.
toasts.importTauthyNewerVersion: This backup was created by a newer version of Tauthy. Update Tauthy and try again.
toasts.importTauthyDuplicateIds: This backup contains duplicate account IDs and cannot be imported safely.
toasts.importTauthyIdConflict: An account in this backup conflicts with a different local account using the same ID.
toasts.importIdConflict: An account in this file has the same ID as a different local account.
toasts.importUnsupportedOtp: The file contains OTP formats Tauthy does not support yet. Only 6-digit SHA-1 TOTP entries with a 30-second period can be imported.
toasts.importFailed: Import failed. Check the file and the selected format.
toasts.importOtpAuthTooLarge: The URI list is too large (maximum 1 MiB).
toasts.importOtpAuthTooMany: The URI list has too many accounts (maximum 500).
toasts.syncConflictMerged: Conflicted copy merged. Keep it until all devices show the recovered accounts.
toasts.syncAuthenticationFailed: The sync recovery password is incorrect, or the file was modified.
toasts.syncConflict: The local and synced vaults contain an account conflict that cannot be merged safely.
toasts.syncLocalConflict: This vault and Pubky sync contain different versions of the same account. Nothing was changed.
toasts.syncCorrupt: The sync data is damaged or invalid.
toasts.syncDeviceFileInvalid: Can't read {{file}}. It may be incomplete, damaged, or from another sync. Keep a copy before changing it; your local vault is safe.
toasts.syncDeviceFileLimit: Sync has more than 32 device files and is paused. Keep the files and make an encrypted backup before seeking help; don't delete device files blindly.
toasts.syncFileExists: A Tauthy Sync folder already exists there. Join it or choose another location.
toasts.syncMultipleFiles: This folder contains multiple sync files. Choose a folder with only one older sync file.
toasts.syncPickerFailed: The location picker could not be opened.
toasts.syncUnavailable: The sync location is currently unavailable. Check that your cloud folder is accessible.
toasts.syncUnsupported: This sync file version or encryption configuration is not supported.
toasts.syncFailed: Sync failed. Your local vault was not lost.
toasts.syncBackgroundFailed: Automatic sync could not finish. Open Settings → Sync for details.
toasts.pubkyUnavailable: Pubky is unavailable or authorization failed. Your local vault was not changed.
toasts.syncRemoteDeleteUnsafe: Unexpected files prevent safe deletion. Nothing was deleted.
toasts.syncRemoteDeleteIncomplete: Could not confirm complete deletion. Some sync files may remain; this device is still connected. Retry before revoking access in Pubky Ring.
toasts.pubkyRingOpenFailed: Could not open Pubky Ring in your browser.
